original_paragraph.Materials and Methods - Surface Plasmon: Surface plasmon resonance data were collected on a Biacore 3000 or Biacore 4000 system (GE Healthcare) at 25 °C. For Biacore 3000 data, streptavidin was immobilized on a CM5 sensor chip (GE Healthcare) using standard amine-coupling chemistry at 25 °C with HBS-N (10 mM HEPES and 0.15 M NaCl, pH 7.4) as the running buffer. The carboxymethyl dextran surface was activated with a 1:1 ratio of 0.4 M 1-ethyl-3-(3-(dimethylamino)propyl) carbodiimide hydrochloride (EDC)/0.1 M N-hydroxy succinimide (NHS) at a flow rate of 10 μL/min. For capture of streptavidin, protein was diluted to 0.1 mg/mL in 10 mM sodium acetate (pH 4.5) and captured by injecting 300 μL onto the activated chip surface. Residual activated groups were blocked with a 7 min injection of 1 M ethanolamine (pH 8.5). hFABP1 and hFABP6 proteins, bearing an N-terminal His6 and Avi-tag, were captured on the streptavidin surface by injection of purified protein diluted to 50–200 μg/mL in 10 mM HEPES pH 7.4/150 mM NaCl. Typical surface densities obtained were 4000–9000 RU. SPR binding data were obtained using appropriate dilution series of each compound at a flow rate of 30–50 μL/min, with a capture time of 60 s and dissociation times of 100 s. Running buffer for compound binding studies was 10 mM HEPES at pH 7.4/150 mM NaCl/0.05% Tween-20/1% DMSO. Data were corrected for DMSO excluded volume effects. All data were double-referenced for blank injections and reference surface using standard processing procedures, and data processing and fitting were performed using Scrubber software, version 2.0c (BioLogic Software). Data were fitted using a simple 1:1 binding model. Fragment screening was carried out with the Charles River fragment screening library of 1460 compounds. For the fragment screen, FABP proteins were immobilized on a streptavidin chip (GE Healthcare) on a Biacore 4000 instrument using a single concentration of each fragment (250 μM), and data were processed with Biacore 4000 instrument software (GE Healthcare). For SPR competition experiments, data were acquired for FABP6 with compounds ±500 μM taurocholate in running buffer and samples.
